title: menu_access_overrides
description: The default menu-access table lives in code (`roles.data.ts`). This collection holds only the cells an admin changed, keyed by menu. Account's key is `account`.

overrides.description: `{ role: "full"|"light"|"hidden" }` for the roles that differ from the default.

createdAt.description: Set by the server on insert.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.
